title: Mid-America Science Museum

services.name: Field Trips
services.desc: Nothing enhances your science lessons like hands-on experiences! Get your students out of the classroom and explore real world science phenomena with over 100 interactive exhibits in the 73,500 square-foot Museum and throughout the 21 wooded acres surrounding the facility. Schools and non-profit organizations qualify for the group rate. Proof of non-profit status must be provided upon registering your group. A minimum two-week advanced registration required in order to receive the group rate. For a full description of all our educational offerings, please download the guide

services.name: Camp
services.desc: Spend the Night at the Museum Looking for a group experience that’s truly unforgettable? Spend the night at Mid-America Science Museum with a Camp-In! Perfect for scout groups, youth organizations, and school groups, this overnight adventure gives campers the rare opportunity to explore the museum after hours. Camp-In

services.name: Birthday Parties
services.desc: Let us help you make your child’s birthday special! Parties must be reserved at least 2 weeks in advance to guarantee preferred dates and times. Available times are: Tuesday, Wednesday, Thursday, Saturdays: 11am, 1pm, 3pm Sundays: 1:30pm, 3:30pm Confetti, helium balloons, piñatas and taping or pinning items on the walls or items hung from the ceiling are not permitted. What do I need to do when I arrive for my party? Check in with Guest Services upon your arrival to the museum. Payment of remaining balances are due upon arrival.
